practice.title: Refactor-and-prove: Components
steps: Take a working example of Components and deliberately introduce one realistic mistake.
Diagnose it from the symptoms alone using the platform SDK, an emulator, and a device or simulator, then fix it.
Record the diagnostic checklist you used so the same fault is found faster next time.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on Components for React Native. Finish it by checking that it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply Components
projects.description: Apply Components for React Native and produce a runnable app screen implementing the target behavior. Then check that it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of Components by producing a runnable app screen implementing the target behavior and verifying that it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.
requirements: A runnable app screen implementing the target behavior that genuinely applies Components for React Native.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.
outcomes: Working project source plus a screen recording.
A short written explanation of Components you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
